_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the elder in the village (hub_village): the baker's quest claimed, the tower, and the chapter's end after Grey Mask. Chapter 2 (23 §4): its end after F10 (c2.done). Chapter 3: its end after F15 (c3.done; the ledger quest paid).

label.zh_TW: 「我在森林裡交了個朋友……大概吧。」
label.en: "I made a friend in the forest... I think."

text.zh_TW: 長老：「好孩子……麵包店又冒煙了。村子好像活過來一點了。」
text.en: Elder: "Good boy... smoke is rising from the bakery again. The village feels a little more alive."

text.zh_TW: 長老：「每一層都有收集者的爪牙。被抓的村民可能被關在任何一層——救出他們，他們就能回家。」
text.en: Elder: "Every floor is full of the Collectors' beasts. The people they took could be held on any floor. Free them, and they can come home."

text.zh_TW: 長老聽完，沉默了很久。「灰面說你是『最後的鑰匙』……里歐，你爹娘從來沒跟你提過，你是從哪裡來的吧？」
text.en: The elder listens, then is silent for a long time. "Grey Mask called you 'the last key'... Leo, your parents never told you where you came from, did they?"

text.zh_TW: 長老：「十二年前的冬夜，你娘抱著一個會發光的嬰兒走進村子。她說：『他會有一個平凡的童年。我保證。』」他抬頭望向高塔。「答案在塔上。你的家人也是。」
text.en: Elder: "Twelve winters ago, your mother walked into the village holding a glowing baby. She said: 'He will have an ordinary childhood. I promise.'" He looks up at the tower. "The answers are up there. So is your family."

text.zh_TW: 長老聽你說完凱和皮普的事，笑出聲來。「皇家騎士和貪財的小怪物？你的運氣真奇怪。」你拿出那封信。他的笑容消失了。
text.en: The elder laughs as you tell him about Kai and Pip. "A royal knight and a greedy little monster? Strange luck you have." You show him the letter. His smile fades.

text.zh_TW: 長老：「故事裡只有一個 L——莉歐拉公主。十年前被關上塔頂的那位。如果她在給你寫信……孩子，這座塔裡的事，比我們想的還要大。」
text.en: Elder: "There's only one L in the old stories: Princess Liora, locked at the top of the tower ten years ago. If she's writing to you... child, what's going on in this tower is bigger than we thought."

text.zh_TW: 長老讀著名冊，手指停在「有記號的孩子」那一行。「……灰面以前是村裡的人？」他沉默了很久。「十二年前，有個年輕人跟你娘一起出現在村口。後來他走了，再也沒回來。」
text.en: The elder reads the ledger, his finger stopping at "the marked child". "...Grey Mask was one of us?" He is quiet for a long time. "Twelve years ago a young man came to the gate with your mother. Later he left, and never came back."

text.zh_TW: 長老：「我記不得他的臉了，只記得他很疼你。」他把名冊還給你。「去問學者『神裔』的事吧。你身上的光……也許就是他們要的東西。」
text.en: Elder: "I can't remember his face. Only that he adored you." He hands the ledger back. "Ask the scholar about the Godborn. That light of yours... may be exactly what they want."
